messages:
maria_api: Quick sync — infra wants a single canonical transport for our internal control plane. My recommendation: gRPC + protobuf internally, with the edge/gateway offering JSON <-> proto transcoding for external clients. We need to lock down routing keys, quota enforcement model, observability fields, and the canary dashboard UX before we ship.

alex.dev: Strong +1 for gRPC internally (lower overhead, streaming options). Biggest friction is dev ergonomics: codegen, slower iteration when folks expect ad-hoc JSON. We'll need ready-made client templates (Node/Python/Go) and a debug story for ops.

jen_prod: Observability caveat: Envoy/JSON-transcoding tends to flatten or drop unknown fields unless we explicitly map them. That can silently kill per-field metrics we rely on. Any mapping must be explicit in the gateway config.

sam_plat: Quotas: gateway-as-single-enforcer is easiest for external traffic, but internal mesh calls will bypass it. Options: 1) gateway enforces for ingress only (simple), 2) sidecar-local quota with periodic reconciliation (scales, resilient). I prefer sidecar local leaky-bucket with reconciliation to central quota service.

kai: Agree on sidecar. Implementation sketch: sidecar keeps a token bucket per-tenant with configurable refill and burst. On startup it syncs limits, then reconciles counters every 10s. It exposes a small /quota-check HTTP endpoint for local service use and emits prometheus metrics for consumed tokens. No global RPC per request.

alex.dev: For routing keys we should standardize an explicit meta proto. Example:

```proto
message RequestMeta {
  string tenant_id = 1;
  string routing_key = 2; // e.g. "low-latency", "cost-optimized", "fallback"
  map<string,string> tags = 3;
}
```

We should also reserve a small routing-class enum for SLO hints.

jen_prod: +1. Also propose proto option/annotation to indicate tolerant fields (i.e., optional/ignored-if-missing) so JSON clients can evolve without breaking internal consumers. We'll add JSON<->proto roundtrip CI checks to catch regressions.

ops_ben: Rollout plan idea: initial canary = 3% of traffic routed to gRPC-only path (internal clients using codegen), 10% using gateway JSON transcoding, compare latency, error-rate, token-burn per-tenant vs baseline. Need Console visuals for those signals.

maria_api: Console UX: add a tiny canary panel showing per-route: p50/p95 latency, errors per-minute, token burn delta (tokens/sec) relative to baseline, and number of quota throttles (per-tenant). Toggle between absolute and percent change. Link to traces for rollback.

sam_plat: Header propagation: we must standardize a single header (x-rw-route) carrying routing_key + small hash and ensure gateway and sidecars preserve it. If something strips or normalizes headers we lose deterministic routing. Consider duplicating routing info into span tags as a fallback.

alex.dev: For debugging, propose including an opaque base64 protobuf blob in trace spans when trace.debug=true, while keeping logs friendly by default. That lets engineers toggle deep inspection without flooding logs with binary.

kai: Observability fields to require in spans: tenant_id, routing_key, token_cost (int), and route_hash. Those let Console compute token burn, attribute cost, and surface regressions across tenants/routes.

jen_prod: Add a CI validation step that runs a full JSON->proto->JSON roundtrip on our sample payloads for every schema change. We had a subtle rename break metric ingestion last week; this would catch that early.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: control-plane/gprc-proto-rtf -> cohort 3% at 2026-11-02T09:04:12Z :rocket:

maria_api: I'll draft a short RFC incorporating: canonical gRPC/proto internal, gateway JSON transcoding for externals, sidecar quota enforcement with 10s reconciliation, required span tags (tenant_id/routing_key/token_cost), x-rw-route header, proto annotations for evolution, and a Console canary panel showing latency/error/token deltas. Will include a sample rollout playbook and the CI JSON<->PROTO roundtrip test script.

sam_plat: Playbook snippets to include in RFC:
- Pre-rollout: run schema roundtrip CI against all example payloads, smoke test gateway transcoding configs in staging.
- Canary: 3% traffic for 24h, monitor p95 latency, 5xx rate, and tokens/sec per-tenant. If tokens surge >20% or 5xx >1.5x baseline, pause.
- Reconciliation: validate sidecar counter divergence <0.5% after 10s.
- Rollback: automatic rollback if error budget breached or token-accounting mismatch persists >30m.

alex.dev: I'll attach client templates and a small debugging checklist to the RFC: how to enable trace.debug, where to find base64 proto blobs, and a script to decode them locally.

jen_prod: I'll add the gateway mapping tests and a short Envoy config example explaining how to map unknown fields safely.

maria_api: Great. Thanks everyone. I'll share the RFC link once drafted and tag infra, SDKs, and observability for quick reviews. :thumbsup:
